definitions.explanation: The counter for small to medium-sized animals, insects, and fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一匹|いっぴき}⟦{飼|か}っている→飼う：08151_kau⟧。
{一匹|いっぴき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
⟦{一匹狼|いっぴきおおかみ}→一匹狼：17823_ippikiookami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
examples.english: They have a lone wolf personality.

notes:
{一匹|いっぴき} is the counter for small to medium-sized animals.

USED FOR:
- ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧、⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧: dogs, cats
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧: fish
- ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧: insects
- ⟦{蛇|へび}→蛇：02246_hebi⟧: snakes
- Small mammals in general

NOT USED FOR:
- Large animals (use ⟦{頭|とう}→頭：18067_tou⟧): ⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧、⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧、⟦{象|ぞう}→象：03328_zou⟧
- Birds (use ⟦{羽|わ}→羽：01007_wa⟧): ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧
- Rabbits (traditionally ⟦{羽|わ}→羽：01007_wa⟧, but ⟦{匹|ひき}→匹：00939_hiki⟧ also used)

COUNTING (sound changes):
- {一匹|いっぴき} (ippiki)
- {二匹|にひき} (nihiki)
- {三匹|さんびき} (sanbiki)
- {四匹|よんひき} (yonhiki)
- {何匹|なんびき} (nanbiki)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{一匹狼|いっぴきおおかみ}→一匹狼：17823_ippikiookami⟧: lone wolf (independent person)
